spanish: Y se acercaron a mí todos ustedes, y dijeron: Enviaremos hombres delante de nosotros, y explorarán para nosotros la tierra, y nos devolverán palabra, el camino que subiremos en ella y las ciudades que vendremos a ellas.

findings.issue: Qal cohortative 1cp is hortative (let us send); “Enviaremos” is future indicative and drops that volitive force.
בָּהּ is the 3fs resumptive of the relative on הַדֶּרֶךְ (the way). Feminine “ella” does not resume masculine “camino” and is read as “la tierra”.

notes: Ustedes with plural verb forms keeps the 2mp address; hiphil שוב is preserved in “devolverán”.
